basis: Published provider prices and issuer-stated procurement requirements; no fictional transactions or executed contract
sql: WITH offers AS (SELECT o.provider,o.plan,o.billing,CAST(o.amount_usd AS DECIMAL(18,2)) amount FROM read_json_auto('/Users/nickgonzales/Developer/Bonfyre/packs/aurekai-work-samples/twc-commercial-facts-20261009.json'),unnest(offers) t(o)) SELECT provider,plan,MAX(CASE WHEN billing='monthly' THEN amount END) monthly_price,MAX(CASE WHEN billing='annual' THEN amount END) annual_price,MAX(CASE WHEN billing='monthly' THEN amount*12 END) twelve_month_payments,CASE WHEN count(*)=2 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN billing='monthly' THEN amount*12 END)-MAX(CASE WHEN billing='annual' THEN amount END) END nominal_annual_saving,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) twc_subcontract_quote,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) aurekai_contribution FROM offers GROUP BY provider,plan ORDER BY provider,plan
